description: Modules that hold an SVG sink and must sit behind the sanitiser they are paired with
rule: An SVG sink is a module that calls unsafeSVG, value-imports an SVG sanitiser, creates a Blob of type image/svg+xml, or is listed here. The sanitisers are src/icons/svg-sanitize.ts and src/svg-image/sanitize.ts (library images). A sink is paired with the sanitiser it value-imports, else the one listed here for it, else svg-sanitize. The paired sanitiser is statically imported in every chunk that holds the sink, or in a chunk on every chain of parent chunks from magic-card.js to it; never only in a sibling or behind its own import(). tools/check-svg-sinks.mjs finds sinks by scanning src and adds the modules below.
